definitions.gloss: piece of meat; slice of meat
definitions.explanation: A cut or piece of meat, typically referring to a slice, chunk, or strip used in cooking.

examples.japanese: {肉片|にくへん}を{鍋|なべ}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Put the pieces of meat into the pot.

examples.japanese: {薄|うす}い{肉片|にくへん}をさっと{焼|や}く。
examples.english: Quickly grill thin slices of meat.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{肉片|にくへん}がごろごろ{入|はい}ったシチューを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a stew with big chunks of meat throughout.

notes:
A compound of {肉|にく} (meat) and {片|へん} (piece, fragment). Used in cooking and food descriptions to refer to cut or sliced pieces of meat. The {片|へん} suffix appears in other food-related compounds like {魚片|ぎょへん} (piece of fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薄切|うすぎ}りの{肉片|にくへん}: thinly sliced pieces of meat
- {肉片|にくへん}を{炒|いた}める: to stir-fry pieces of meat
- {肉片|にくへん}を{煮込|にこ}む: to stew pieces of meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肉|にく}: meat (general) — the basic word, does not imply it is cut into pieces
- {切|き}り{身|み}: fillet, cut of meat or fish — more specific to a prepared cut
- {薄切|うすぎ}り{肉|にく}: thinly sliced meat — specifies the cutting method
- {角切|かくぎ}り{肉|にく}: cubed meat — specifies the shape of the cut

cross_references.label: fillet, cut of meat or fish
